rationale: All deterministic functional and art checks pass. The dedicated positive-integer-list helper rejects malformed, overflowing, and duplicate IDs; the command validates all IDs before mutation, updates selected tasks through one atomic store write, reports stable sorted integer sets, remains idempotent, and keeps JSON output banner-free. Help and focused fixture tests cover required inputs, malformed values, unknown-task atomicity, persistence, summaries, repeated calls, banner constraints, and existing commands. The banner is immediately recognizable as a successful TaskForge bulk completion: strong outer framing, centered subject and status, a nested selected-tasks panel, balanced whitespace, and consistent proportions make it legible at terminal size. The diff is focused; the added line-ending rule is directly relevant to the exact LF asset contract, though adding a repository-level attributes file is a small extra surface.
